new_findings.title: SwapModeText numeric labels drift from the MQL5 ENUM_SYMBOL_SWAP_MODE ABI from value 4 upward
new_findings.detail: Official ABI: 0 DISABLED, 1 POINTS, 2 CURRENCY_SYMBOL, 3 CURRENCY_MARGIN, 4 CURRENCY_DEPOSIT, 5 INTEREST_CURRENT, 6 INTEREST_OPEN, 7 REOPEN_CURRENT, 8 REOPEN_FIXED (9 does not exist). EA labels: 4 MARGIN_CURRENT, 5 CURRENCY_DEPOSIT, 6 INTEREST_CURRENT, 7 INTEREST_OPEN, 8 REOPEN_CURRENT, 9 REOPEN_FIXED. Mitigated by design: swap_mode_raw is the authoritative column and A7 re-maps independently; OANDA majors typically serve 0/1. Non-blocking; recommend correcting labels + dropping the unreachable case 9 before F7 compile (cheap).

new_findings.title: TradeModeText (ACCOUNT enum labels) reused for SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE; no raw column to re-derive
new_findings.detail: ENUM_SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE is 0 DISABLED / 1 LONGONLY / 2 SHORTONLY / 3 CLOSEONLY / 4 FULL. Applying ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_* text (0 DEMO / 1 CONTEST / 2 REAL) yields: every normally tradable (FULL=4) symbol records trade_mode=UNKNOWN, and a DISABLED(0) symbol would record the actively misleading 'DEMO'. Unlike swap_mode there is NO raw trade_mode column, so the text cannot be re-derived from the file. probe_contract.json pins the same wrong label set ('trade_mode (DEMO/CONTEST/REAL text from SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE)'), so contract and EA are internally consistent - but both are semantically wrong. No floor (F1-F5), smoke criterion, or read-only guarantee depends on this informational column, hence non-blocking; recommend a dedicated 0-4 mapping + raw column (and verifier spec width 26->27) before F7 compile. Note the account-level trade mode (the DEMO-caveat question reserved to A7) IS collected correctly via ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE.

new_findings.title: Verifier argv guard incomplete (F-14 PARTIAL)
new_findings.detail: argval 'never raises' claim falsified by two measured invocations: dangling --window-days (no value) -> IndexError exit 1; --window-days abc -> ValueError exit 1. Both fail loudly with no partial output and cannot corrupt data; the owner-facing invocation in OWNER_RUN.md passes no such flags. Non-blocking.

new_findings.title: Midnight-end session served as to==0 would render 00:00, not 24:00
new_findings.detail: F-13 remediation converts only tsec==0 with (long)to>0 (covers the to=86400 representation and multi-day to). A build serving a midnight end as literal 0 is indistinguishable from unset and would render 00:00. Sessions are informational; no floor depends on them. Unobservable offline.

new_findings.title: Verifier embeds every parsed row in verdict_inputs.json
new_findings.detail: inputs['parse'] holds all rows of all files; at 7-day scale (~600k tick rows at 5s x 5 symbols) verdict_inputs.json will be very large (hundreds of MB) and memory-heavy. Functional, deterministic, and correctness-neutral; practicality consideration for the post-collection audit run.
